articles.summary:
Woking, UK, October 27, 2025 – Linde plc (Nasdaq: LIN) announced its Board of Directors has declared a quarterly dividend of $1.50 per share.

The dividend is payable on December 17, 2025 to shareholders of record on December 3, 2025.
articles.title: Linde Declares Dividend in Fourth Quarter 2025

articles.summary: Woking, UK, October 31, 2025 – Linde plc (Nasdaq: LIN) today reported its third quarter 2025 financial results.
articles.title: Linde Reports Third Quarter 2025 Results
